hard_requirement: No tileset/pack is assumed complete. Semantic scene requirements remain separate from available permitted assets; missing assets remain explicit or use an approved placeholder rather than silent invention.

mai10_start.corpus: all fourteen MAI-01 source classes plus current MAI projection/geometry/permission/outcome branches and bounded Tiled/LDtk/Foundry adapter proof cases, including explicit unsupported/degraded/ambiguous negatives
mai10_start.performance: self-hosted Linux/Windows exact-head measurement; one warm-up + five samples; only approved numerical budget adopted is bounded-corpus search/filter <150 ms median target; remaining MAI pipeline operations measure/report only
mai10_start.interoperability: read-only proof across MAI-01 source evidence through MAI-09 integration/reconciliation, preserving explicit failure states and owner authority
mai10_start.determinism: platform-neutral mai10 receipt excludes raw timings and compares corpus/stage/budget verdicts
